artifacts.notes: Patent drawing on artifact page 1; specification on artifact page 2. Figure 1 shows a long supporting rod with a taper tube and separate branch ending in an extinguisher bell. The patented air bulb, button, internal spring, plates, tubes, joints, exact ornament, and dimensions are excluded from the generic teaching synthesis.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1902 United States federal patent publication is a United States government work and is also public domain by publication date. The retained Google Patents delivery is a mechanical facsimile of that public-domain record.

work.author: Noe Galipeau
work.description: A 1902 United States patent specification for an extinguisher with a connected lighter taper. It supplies dated material-culture evidence for the combined long-shaft, taper-tube, and extinguisher-bell family; its patented pneumatic mechanism is not generalized.
work.title: Extinguisher
